name: Defiant Orc Head
summary: The Defiant Orc Head is found near Swamplight Manor at Witch Hill in Dustwallow Marsh. It is the severed head of an orc whose death Nazeer Bloodpike seeks to understand.

sections.title: A grim discovery
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village recognizes the head as Marg Nighteye's. The ragged wound leaves him unsure whether a weapon or a beast killed the orc. He fears Marg may have fallen to the Alliance, and sends the matter onward for answers.

faq.answer: The head belongs to Marg Nighteye, an orc agent whose death alarms Nazeer Bloodpike.

faq.q: Where do I find the Defiant Orc Head?
faq.answer: It is found in loose dirt beside Swamplight Manor at Witch Hill in Dustwallow Marsh, after the lost report is recovered.
Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village wants the head so he can investigate Marg Nighteye's death.
Kin'weelay is a powerful Darkspear witchdoctor whom Nazeer believes may speak with Marg Nighteye's spirit.
Nazeer sees a ragged cut at Marg's neck and wonders whether a weapon or a beast killed him; he fears the Alliance may be responsible.

angles.text: As an orc, Marg Nighteye's death is a grim reminder that his people are caught in dangerous work far from home.
As a troll, you know Kin'weelay is sought for his witch-magic and his power to speak with spirits.
